items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1962-04-11
items.q: Sherry? You know Dr. Sherry? I don't know him. But you heard talking.

ctx.x: For the E record. What about E flat clarinet? Was there anybody special on the street there?
Right until Ed and Sherry. Ed and Sherry, he was like a white boy.
Well, he played with white bands too, I know. Oh yeah, he played with white bands. Dave Perkins or something.
